name: Cystic Fibrosis
overview: Cystic Fibrosis is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: In routine practice, cystic fibrosis (CF) is a genetic disorder inherited in an autosomal recessive manner that impairs the normal clearance of mucus from the lungs...
In routine practice, cF is a rare genetic disorder that affects mostly the lungs, but also the pancreas, liver, kidneys, and intestine.
From a clinical perspective, the hallmark feature of CF is the accumulation of thick mucus in different organs.
In routine practice, long-term issues include difficulty breathing and coughing up mucus as a result of frequent lung infections.
